column_description: Unique identifier for each vaccination data entry.
Reference to the country. may be NULL.
Date for which the vaccination data is recorded. may be NULL.
Percentage of population fully vaccinated. may be NULL.
Smoothed rate of new vaccinations per million population. may be NULL.
Total number of vaccinations administered up to the recorded date. may be NULL.
Types of vaccines used in the country. may be NULL.
Date when a significant percentage of the population is fully vaccinated. may be NULL.
Source of the data (e.g., WHO, CDC, local health authorities). always exactly one of 'WHO', 'CDC', 'local health authorities'. may be NULL.
